## Checklist

- [ ] **Scoped to one thing** — no adjacent refactors, renames, or dependencies the task didn't need. Found something else worth fixing? File it as a separate issue instead of folding it in.
- [ ] **Tested** — existing tests still pass, and new behavior has new tests, not just manual verification that isn't written down.
- [ ] **Honest about anything stubbed** — if part of this is a placeholder, say so explicitly in a code comment and here, not silently.
- [ ] **Docs updated in this PR** — if this changes what a README or `HANDOFF.md` claims, that file is updated here, not left as a follow-up that may never happen.
